originality.rationale: FAIL: Petersen, Inquiry-Based Enumerative Combinatorics (2019), Chapter 10 pp.143–146, FULL relevant primary text inspected, explicitly treats prime decomposition and states P(q,z)^k counts Dyck paths with exactly k prime factors; it then refines these same prime factors by area and proves C(q,z)=Σ_k P(q,z)^k=1/(1−P(q,z)) with P(q,z)=z C(q,qz). Since completed-return count R is exactly the number k of prime factors, introducing u merely replaces that explicitly given series by G(q,z,u)=Σ_k u^k P(q,z)^k=1/(1−uP(q,z)), with the standard affine change from lattice area to step-height area. This prior all-area/all-returns coefficient generator mathematically determines every joint moment; submitted covariance is obtained through routine q,u differentiation and Catalan coefficient simplification. The bare negative sign and correlation constant are tidy consequences of that prior stronger joint enumerator; no genuinely independent invariant remains after this implication. This is a coverage rejection, not a proof failure or an absent-string argument.
